item.title: GIFT: LLM-Guided State-Reward Interface Design for Financial RL
item.description:
Embeds LLM code generation into a PPO portfolio-RL pipeline — the LLM designs state and reward interfaces instead of trading directly, avoiding online-inference latency. Focuses on using language models as interface designers for financial reinforcement learning rather than as online decision agents.

Mar – May 2026 · Core member · Submitted to ACL ARR May 2026 (target: EMNLP 2026)
